# omni-ui

> Native apps and a light-use web browser (Omni Web) drawn by the omni-render engine: one packed widget tree is both drawn and read by assistive technology, and a broker plus one confined process per page.

Setup: `git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-ui && cd omni-ui && git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/SovRing-Labs/omni-render ../omni-render && tools/pin-engine.sh $(git -C ../omni-render rev-parse HEAD) && cargo build --release && python3 tests/verify_calendar.py` (expect: exit 0).
Status: pre-alpha, under development — read STATUS.md before relying on a number.
Licence: MIT OR Apache-2.0 (omni-ui-t25 binary PolyForm).
